statisticsScope.fallbackReason: Mirrors the public MetaTFT comps page rank scope and visibility rules; rank fallback is disabled.

disclaimer: Static pre-game reference only. Composition item order follows MetaTFT item play rate; holder ranks remain correlations from complete three-item builds.

itemStatBasis.aggregation: For each comp and unit, weighted average of complete three-item build rows containing the item.
